as_told.title: Hoagland's Dark Mission: NASA as an occult organisation

plain: NASA, the US space agency, is said to be run partly like an occult, ritual-driven organisation with a hidden history. That claim comes from Dark Mission: The Secret History of NASA, a book by the writer Richard Hoagland, published in 2007. Michels brings the book up in two episodes about life on Mars, admits it is very controversial, and says Hoagland made claims like those discussed with his guests.
